note: Gang heat (PLAN.md W5; user 2026-10-03): one heat per (player, gang), INDEPENDENT of the police stars and NOT cleared by a hospitalisation or an arrest. Stars from heat by `stars_at`. At `attack_at` stars that gang's members (the crowd's included) attack the player on sight; at `chase_at` they hunt the player (the dispatch, not built yet). Below `pay_at` stars the heat drains after `calm_seconds` at `decay_per_second`; at or above `pay_at` it only goes away by paying the gang's `fee_per_star` x stars yen as a 'donation' at one of that gang's gray-area counters. Police do not care about gang heat. Adding a gang = one entry in `gangs`; a gang crime = one row in `crimes` + one GangSystem.report call.
